findings.highlight: an inexhaustible resource that mages from around the world gather here to use.
findings.evidenceJa: 世界中の魔術師がここに集まって、好き勝手魔力をくみ上げようと尽きない貯蔵量。
findings.governingReading: Even all mages worldwide gathering and drawing freely would not exhaust store.
findings.explanation: Hypothetical worldwide mage drain becomes actual gathering to use reserve.

findings.highlight: Humans live such boring, pointless lives before I play with them. And I get thirsty, too.
findings.evidenceJa: 人間は潰していないと毎日がつまらなくて意味がないし、飲まないと渇いて苦しいでしょう？
findings.governingReading: Ruby reads crushing as playing: humans find daily life boring and meaningless without play and suffer thirst without drinking. Sakura uses normal human needs to normalize her crushing and swallowing.
findings.explanation: Humans' need to play becomes victim lives empty until Sakura plays with them.

findings.highlight: "...Okay. So you're going to take your anger out on anyone you see. But what about Shirou? He still thinks that he can save you. Are you going murder him, too?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「……そ。で、目に付くものなら片っ端から八つ当たりするワケか。けど士郎はどうなの。あいつは今でもアンタを助けられると信じてる。それでも関係なく、アンタはあいつをやっちゃう気？」
findings.governingReading: Rin asks whether Sakura intends to kill Shirou too.

findings.highlight: No one's coming to save you this time. Drown in the Cup of Heaven, like a bug fallen into a lake."
findings.evidenceJa: 今度は誰も助けに来ない。湖に落ちた虫みたいに、天の杯に溺れなさい」
findings.governingReading: 天の杯 bears このわたし ruby: she tells Rin to drown in this me, identifying engulfing vessel with herself.
